heading_path: Buyer's Guide Choose a solicitation method - Invitation to tender
blocks.markdown: Invitation to tender Use an Invitation to tender (ITT) when selection is based on the lowest price. In addition, all the following criteria must apply: two or more sources are capable of carrying out the requirement the requirement is adequately defined to permit an evaluation of offers against clearly stated criteria the market conditions are such that offers can be submitted on a common pricing basis the intention is to accept the lowest-priced responsive offer without negotiations the evaluation of offers will exclude any product, resource, operating and contingency costs or socio-economic considerations, other than the employment equity provisions Before issuing an ITT , you must verify the Ineligibility and Suspension List to ensure that the invited offerors are not ineligible, if they have not been selected from a prequalified list. The ITT must include the Ineligibility and Suspension Policy Clauses. You can announce an ITT : through public advertisement on GETS through direct invitation through a source list by invitation to one source only if conditions for a non-competitive process have been met An ITT can be opened publicly and is recommended for requirements estimated to exceed $25,000. For ITT s below $25,000, public opening may be held if circumstances warrant. You should consider public openings for any bid where the contract award will have significant public visibility.
